Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [제어] Root a Restless Amani with its Gravebound Advance shield still up using Earthgrab Totem to delay it reaching the well.
@m [참고] Spells being cast are interrupted the moment Invoke ends, so stop casting Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst at that moment.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Wind Shear.

Entombed Sentinels: [우선 처치] When a Venom Coagulation ooze spawns, pop Stormkeeper to kill it right away.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Ascendance until after the intermission.
[생존기] When soaking Unstable Miasma, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.

Vashnik the Malignant: [우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Chain Lightning and Earthquake before they reach the center.
[제어] Burning Venom can be stunned with Capacitor Totem or rooted with Earthgrab Totem until Hardened Venom.
@m [생존기] Line up Astral Shift with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Wind Shear.
[위치] If you are the Blink Nova target, get away from the raid quickly with Gust of Wind or Ghost Wolf.
[회피] Keep casting with Spiritwalker's Grace while moving to dodge Shell Spin shells and Evil Eyes flames.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Ascendance and Stormkeeper with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.
[회피] Keep casting with Spiritwalker's Grace while moving to dodge the Tempest whirlwinds.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Kill the Venomous Emergence adds first by popping Stormkeeper and using Chain Lightning.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Caustic Globule's Barbed Bulwark with Wind Shear.

The Coiled Altar: [차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so dump Ascendance.
[회피] After soaking Guillotine, immediately get 40 yards away from the axe with Gust of Wind or Ghost Wolf.

Ula'tek: [해제] Clear the Acidic Burst poison from Blightscale Viper off allies within 30 yards with Poison Cleansing Totem.
[우선 처치] Dump Ascendance and Stormkeeper into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with Wind Shear.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Chain Lightning and Earthquake before they reach the bubble.
[위치] When you are the Chilling Frost target and have to move slowly, keep casting with Spiritwalker's Grace.
[생존기] Line up Astral Shift with the raid damage from Pop! and Unending Tides.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Voidmaw packs with Earthquake and Chain Lightning.
@m [해제] Abyssal Malus's Black Miasma is a Curse, so remove it with Cleanse Spirit.

Vorasius: [회피] During Void Breath, leap forward with Gust of Wind to reach the far end of the room opposite the glowing hand.
[우선 처치] Kill the Blistercreeps gathered at the wall together with Earthquake so Blisterburst breaks the Void Crystal.
@m [생존기] When the first Blistercreep pack pops, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from distant Fractured Images with Wind Shear or hold them with Capacitor Totem.
[참고] The boss takes 25% more damage during the 20 sec Entropic Unraveling, so line up Ascendance with it and reduce the raid damage with Astral Shift.
[회피] Keep casting with Spiritwalker's Grace while moving to dodge Umbral Beams.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [차단] Interrupt Voidorb's Voidbolt with Wind Shear or hold it with Capacitor Totem.
[분담] When taking Gloomtouched in the Gloom path, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [참고] The Divine Shield the boss casts after Bloodlust can be removed by an enemy buff dispel, so remove it with Purge.
[차단] After breaking War Chaplain Senn's Sacred Shield, interrupt Blinding Light with Wind Shear.
[분담] When soaking Execution Sentence next to the target, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Crown of the Cosmos: [참고] Stop casting Lava Burst when Demiar's Interrupting Tremor cast finishes.
[우선 처치] Kill the Void Droplets under the sentinel by hitting them together with the sentinel using Earthquake.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with Wind Shear or hold it with Capacitor Totem.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Ascendance to break the adds' Alnshroud shields quickly.
@m [분담] If you are on the Rift Madness swap, use Gust of Wind to reach the target quickly and switch realms.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] If your feather color matches, interrupt the embers' Light Eruption or Void Eruption with Wind Shear.
[생존기] Bloodlust goes on the first egg phase, so when Rebirth starts, use Bloodlust or Heroism and dump Ascendance.
[분담] When soaking Light Dive or Void Dive with same-color players, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Interrupt the Safeguard Matrix's Safeguard casts with Wind Shear and Capacitor Totem, and strip the stacked Safeguard buff with Purge.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with Wind Shear.
@m [생존기] Bloodlust is used in Phase 3, so use Bloodlust or Heroism then.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Always interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with Wind Shear, and take the second Sporecap that spawns far away from range.
@hm [해제] Clear a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts off nearby players with Poison Cleansing Totem.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Shroomlings and Bursting Shrooms gathered at the set spot with Earthquake and Chain Lightning.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Poison Cleansing Totem은 digest 해제 목록에서 독으로 확인된 Acidic Burst에만 썼다. Cleanse Spirit이 지울 저주 디버프는 digest에 없다
Gravebound Advance 보호막을 깨는 피해 속성은 적지 않았다. Farseer·Stormbringer 전용 기술(Ancestral Swiftness·Tempest 등)은 넣지 않았다
1시즌: Cleanse Spirit·Poison Cleansing Totem은 kit.dispel 기준으로 digest 해제 목록의 저주(Black Miasma)·독(Poison Burst)에만 썼다. Purge는 digest가 적 버프 해제를 요구한 Divine Shield·Safeguard에만 썼다
1시즌: Capacitor Totem은 digest가 기절을 허용한 Shadow Fracture·Voidbolt·Void Barrage·Safeguard에 썼다. 선견자·폭풍인도자 영웅 특성 전용 기술(Ancestral Swiftness·Tempest 등)은 넣지 않았다
